name: Guided Stim
description: Guided Stim: adds the P-11G Guided Stim Pistol, a P-11 whose darts home in on your squadmates, fly faster and flatter, and give the medic a small heal for each patch-up. The usual guided lock-on reticle will not appear, but the darts are still guided after firing. Needs Chemical Agents on your synced account.
